versions.name: James C. Justice National Scout Camp

features.note: A shower house next to the campsites, with ambient-temperature water.
A BMX track and skatepark in the wheeled sports area.
The Brownsea Island programme for new Scouts.
Fishing and fly-fishing at the camp's fish camp.
A water obstacle course at Goodrich Lake.
Participants get access to some of the reserve's high-adventure venues.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA and Venturing resident camp at the Summit Bechtel Reserve in West Virginia, offering more than 70 merit badges, the Brownsea first-year program, and access to high-adventure venues including whitewater, ziplining, BMX, and mountain biking.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
